headline: Executive order aimed at making American universities more open about money and influence they receive from foreign sources.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order focuses on transparency about foreign influence at US colleges and universities. It likely directs federal agencies to push schools to disclose foreign gifts, contracts, or other ties more fully. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, deadlines, and penalties are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They may face stricter federal expectations to report foreign funding or ties.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign governments, companies, and donors that give money to US schools
who_it_affects.how: Their gifts or contracts with American universities may be more likely to be reported publicly.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 23, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the available information.
